maintenance_led.reason: Sells newly made closures, metal food cans and custom plastic containers to consumer goods companies; consumable packaging, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private consumer products and food companies, paid by private businesses and consumers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from manufacturing and selling packaging to existing customers, with occasional acquisitions rather than a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Dispensing closures and food and pharma containers are qualified into customers' products; switching needs re-qualification and validation.

notes: Silgan has made many acquisitions over the years, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call.
